entries.name: OpenWebNinja Books Search
entries.description: Search for books, newspapers and magazines across the web via the Google Books SERP — returns matching titles with authors, publication year, cover image, preview/full-view links, more-editions links and rank, with pagination and filters for document type, view type, publication-year range, country and language.

query.description: Search query / keyword, e.g. 'atomic habits' or 'james clear'.

page.description: Results page to return (pagination / scrolling); ~10 results per page.

document_type.description: Find items of a specific type.

view_type.description: Filter by the view available for the item (preview / full).

publication_year_from.description: Find books published after a specific year (e.g. 1980).

publication_year_to.description: Find books published before a specific year (e.g. 2013).

items.description: id (Google Books volume id), title, subtitle (authors + publication year), image_url (cover, may be a data: URI placeholder or null), view_url (Google Books page), view_label (Preview/Full view; omitted when no preview), publication_year, book_authors[{name,url}], book_more_editions_url, position (1-based within page), rank (1-based across pages).

usage.callShape: GET https://x402.openwebninja.com/realtime-serp-data/books/search?query=<keyword>&page=1&country=us&language=en — pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum). Results are returned inline in the 200 JSON under data[]; no polling. Increment page for the next set (~10 results/page).
usage.outputShape: { status:'OK', request_id, parameters:{query,country,language,view_type,document_type}, data:[ { id, title, subtitle, image_url, view_url, view_label, publication_year, book_authors:[{name,url}], book_more_editions_url, position, rank } ] }. Verified with query='atomic habits' -> HTTP 200, 10 book results (e.g. 'Atomic Habits: The life-changing million-copy #1 bestseller' by James Clear, 2018, with Google Books view_url and more-editions link).
quirks: query is the only required param; page paginates (~10 results per page).

Flat price $0.003 per call (amount 3000, USDC 6dp), quoted identically in the 402 across Base (eip155:8453), Polygon (eip155:137) and Arbitrum (eip155:42161); the exact amount is always in the endpoint's own 402 challenge.
image_url is frequently a 1x1 data:image/gif base64 placeholder (or null) rather than a real cover URL — the real cover loads client-side on Google Books; treat image_url as best-effort.
document_type also covers newspapers and magazines, not just books; view_type filters for preview/full-view availability.
This is the Google Books SERP vertical. The provider also exposes an identical alias at /realtime-books-data/search on the same host; either path returns the same data and the same $0.003 price.
usage.guide: Search books/newspapers/magazines across the web via the Google Books SERP. GET https://x402.openwebninja.com/realtime-serp-data/books/search with query params: ?query=<keyword, required, e.g. 'atomic habits'>, &page=<1-based, default 1, ~10 results/page>, &document_type=<any|books|newspapers|magazines>, &view_type=<any|preview_and_full_view|full_view>, &publication_year_from=<year>, &publication_year_to=<year>, &country=<2-letter, default us>, &language=<2-letter, default en>. Pay per call via x402 (flat $0.003 USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum; no API key). Read results from data[] — title, authors (book_authors[].name), year (publication_year), Google Books page (view_url), preview availability (view_label), more editions (book_more_editions_url), cover (image_url, often a placeholder). Paginate by incrementing page. Result is synchronous in the 200; no polling. Verified 2026-07-30 with query='atomic habits' -> HTTP 200, $0.003 charged, 10 results returned.

query.description: Search query / keyword for short videos, e.g. 'cooking recipes'.

time.description: Find shorts posted in a specific relative time range.

posted_date_from.description: Find shorts posted after a specific date (e.g. 1/19/2025).

posted_date_to.description: Find shorts posted before a specific date (e.g. 3/19/2025).

closed_captioned.description: Return only shorts with closed captions.

status.description: The status of the API response (e.g. 'OK').

usage.callShape: GET https://x402.openwebninja.com/realtime-serp-data/shorts/search?query=<keyword>&page=1 — pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum). entries.name: X402node Chinese Shopping SERP
entries.description: Chinese-language Google Shopping SERP: query Google Shopping with Chinese keywords and get structured product listings (title, price, seller, rating, link), localized to zh-CN with regional targeting (default hk; also tw/sg). For cross-border ecommerce price research and product discovery in Chinese-speaking markets.

country.description: 2-letter region code, default hk (hk/tw/sg; cn has no Google Shopping data)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/serp/cn-shopping?keyword=<term>&country=<hk|tw|sg> — query-string params, no JSON body. Both keyword and country are required per the x402 bazaar schema (country defaults to hk server-side if omitted). x402 paid (~$0.015 USDC on Base or Solana).
usage.outputShape: body.{query, type ('shopping'), country, hl ('zh-CN'), count, results[].{title, link (Google Shopping product URL), price (localized, e.g. 'HK$5,699.00'), source, rating}, note}
quirks: keyword is intended for Chinese product terms (中文商品关键词) but English terms also work — Google Shopping HK returns zh-CN localized listings either way (verified with keyword=laptop, country=HK).
country only accepts Chinese-speaking regions: hk (default), tw, sg. Mainland cn has NO Google Shopping coverage — passing cn falls back to hk.
Results are localized to hl=zh-CN: titles/prices come back in the target market (e.g. prices like 'HK$5,699.00').
The `source` (seller) and `rating` fields were returned EMPTY strings for every result in the verified run — do not rely on them; use title, link, and price.
This is the dedicated Chinese shopping SERP; for generic/global Google Shopping use /serp/shopping ($0.02), and for combined Chinese web/news/shopping use /serp/cn (type=shopping).
Accepts payment on Base OR Solana USDC — either network works, same $0.015.
usage.guide: Chinese-language Google Shopping SERP. Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/serp/cn-shopping with query params keyword (the product term, required) and country (hk default, or tw/sg — NOT cn, which has no Google Shopping data). Pay ~$0.015 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana (no API key). The response is synchronous JSON: read body.results[], each with title, link (Google Shopping product URL), and price (localized, e.g. 'HK$5,699.00'). Note that source (seller) and rating fields often come back empty. Use for cross-border ecommerce price research and product discovery in Chinese-speaking markets.

entries.name: OpenWebNinja Web Search
entries.description: Real-time full-depth Google web search (SERP) — returns organic results (title, URL, snippet, source, domain, date, rank) plus ads, AI overviews, knowledge graph, places, top stories, inline videos, answer box and discussions, with Google Advanced Search operators, city-level geo targeting and pagination.

q.description: Search query. Supports all Google Advanced Search operators (site:, inurl:, intitle:, etc.).

gl.description: Country/region for the query — 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

tbs.description: Advanced Google search params not available otherwise (e.g. qdr:d for last day, qdr:w for last week).

location.description: Where the search originates from; recommended at city level (e.g. 'London, England, United Kingdom'). See https://api.openwebninja.com/google-search-locations.json.

lr.description: Restrict results to specific language(s): lang_{code} with | delimiter (e.g. lang_fr|lang_de).

nfpr.description: nfpr=1 excludes auto-corrected-query results for a misspelled query; 0 includes them (default).

nhr.description: nhr=1 excludes 'People also ask' related questions; 0 includes them (default).

num.description: Maximum number of organic results per request (1-10).

start.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

fetch_ai_overviews.description: Return AI Overviews when available (false by default). When enabled and available, consumes an extra request credit.

return_organic_result_video_thumbnail.description: Return a base64-encoded video_thumbnail for organic video results (false by default).

request_id.description: Unique ID to trace the request.

parameters.description: Echo of the request parameters used (q, gl, hl, num, start, nfpr, nhr, fetch_ai_overviews, return_organic_result_video_thumbnail, deduplicate, and any location/lr/tbs when passed).

total_organic_results.description: Approximate total number of organic results Google reports for the query.

items.description: title, url, snippet, source, displayed_link, domain, date, snippet_highlighted_words[], position (1-based within page), rank (1-based across pages); video results add video_preview_url/video_duration; shopping results may add price; video_thumbnail (base64) only when return_organic_result_video_thumbnail=true.

ads.description: Sponsored / ad results when Google surfaces them.

has_ai_overviews.description: Whether AI Overviews are available for the query (content returned only when fetch_ai_overviews is enabled).

data.description: Also includes AI overviews, knowledge graph, places, top stories, inline videos, answer box and discussions blocks when Google surfaces them for the query.

usage.callShape: GET https://x402.openwebninja.com/realtime-web-search/search-full?q=<query>&gl=us&hl=en&num=10 — pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum; no API key). Results returned inline in the 200 JSON under data.organic_results[]; no polling. Paginate via start (skip N) and cap organic results with num (1-10).
usage.outputShape: { status:'OK', request_id, parameters:{q,gl,hl,num,start,nfpr,nhr,fetch_ai_overviews,...}, data:{ total_organic_results, organic_results:[ {title,url,snippet,source,displayed_link,domain,date,snippet_highlighted_words[],position,rank} ], ads[], has_ai_overviews, plus ai_overviews/knowledge_graph/places/top_stories/videos/answer_box/discussions when present } }. Verified with q='coffee' -> HTTP 200, total_organic_results 176, 9 organic results (Wikipedia rank 1, Britannica, plus a YouTube video result with video_duration and shopping result with price), has_ai_overviews=true.
quirks: q is the only required param; gl (country) and hl (language) default to us/en.
num caps organic results at 1-10 per request; use start to paginate (skip N results).

openapi notes each request consumes 2 request credits (heavy 'full-depth' serp path), and fetch_ai_overviews=true adds another credit when overviews are available — but the x402 price is a flat $0.003 (amount 3000, USDC 6dp) regardless, quoted identically across Base (eip155:8453), Polygon (eip155:137) and Arbitrum (eip155:42161).
has_ai_overviews only signals availability; set fetch_ai_overviews=true to actually receive AI Overview content.
Supports Google Advanced Search operators inside q (site:, inurl:, intitle:) plus tbs (e.g. qdr:d/qdr:w for recency) and city-level geo via location.
The exact amount is always in the endpoint's own 402 challenge.
usage.guide: Full-depth real-time Google web search (SERP). GET https://x402.openwebninja.com/realtime-web-search/search-full with query params: ?q=<query, required — supports Google operators site:/inurl:/intitle:>, &gl=<2-letter country, default us>, &hl=<2-letter language, default en>, &num=<1-10 organic results, default 10>, &start=<pagination offset, default 0>, and optional &tbs=<qdr:d|qdr:w|...>, &location=<city, e.g. 'London, England, United Kingdom'>, &lr=<lang_fr|lang_de>, &nfpr=<0|1>, &nhr=<0|1>, &fetch_ai_overviews=<true to include AI Overviews>, &return_organic_result_video_thumbnail=<true for base64 video thumbnails>. Pay per call via x402 (flat $0.003 USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum; no API key). Read results from data.organic_results[] — each has title, url, snippet, source, domain, date, position and rank; the response also carries ads, knowledge_graph, places, top_stories, videos, answer_box, discussions and (when fetch_ai_overviews) AI overviews. Result is synchronous in the 200; no polling. Verified 2026-08-07 with q='coffee' -> HTTP 200, $0.003 charged, 9 organic results (total_organic_results 176).
